title: The instruction contradicts itself on when operating results start, and the all-or-nothing verifier rejects the other reading
evidence: problem.py says: "Acquisition closes 3/31/2016 (start of Q1). The Q1 End balance sheet reflects post-acquisition position only; operating results first appear in Q2." But the GT computes full Q1 operating results (C43=160, C44=5.395, C47=108.92) and only posts them to the Q2 Start balance sheet (F22 = D22+C43-C54 = 242; F31 = D31+C47). A competent agent could read "operating results first appear in Q2" to mean the Q1 2016 income statement / affiliate income stays at zero, or that Q2 Start equals Q1 End. Either reading changes dozens of graded cells. verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (weight 1, the only check) scores 1.0 only if every modified cell in B2:G55 matches within 1%. Otherwise it scores 0, so a reasonable alternative reading gets 0.
confirmation: The instruction admits the reading 'Q1 income is zero / Q2 Start = Q1 End', which the three runs adopted. The golden instead populates Q1 C43:C55 and posts them at F, and the single all-or-nothing verifier rejects the alternative.
fix: Same prompt sentence change as verifier-correctness-0.

title: Answer key changes balances between the same quarter-end and next-quarter opening
evidence: The task states: 'The Q1 End balance sheet reflects post-acquisition position only; operating results first appear in Q2.' Both D21 (Q1 End) and F21 (Q2 Start) are dated '6/30/2016', but the golden workbook inserts an entire quarter's results between them. For example, F22 '=D22+C43-C54' increases cash from 138 to 242; investment increases from 4.5 to 9.895; equity increases from 145 to 253.9229375. Thus the closing and immediately following opening balance sheets disagree despite sharing the same date. The sole verifier, weighted 1, requires every modification cell to match this key, so a consistent opening-balance rollover fails the entire check.
confirmation: D21 'Q1 End' and F21 'Q2 Start' are both 6/30/2016, yet the golden F22=D22+C43-C54 (cash 138 to 242) and F31=D31+C47, so a normal opening-balance rollover fails the sole verifier.
fix: Same prompt sentence change as verifier-correctness-0.

title: Task instruction ('operating results first appear in Q2') contradicts Ground Truth ('gt_07_03_golden.xlsx') Q1 income statement and Q2 Start balance sheet
evidence: In problem.py:34, the instruction states: 'Complete the equity method accounting exercise. Acquisition closes 3/31/2016 (start of Q1). The Q1 End balance sheet reflects post-acquisition position only; operating results first appear in Q2.' However, in the ground truth workbook (gt_07_03_golden.xlsx), graded by 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells, weight: 1): (1) the Q1 2016 Income Statement and supporting schedules (C43:C55) are fully populated with Q1 operating and affiliate results (C43='=C41-C42'=160, C50='=C8*C38'=5.5, C51='=C15/C16/4'=0.105, C44='=C50-C51'=5.395, C45='=C43+C44'=165.395, C54='=C43*C36'=56, C55='=C44*(1-C37)*C36'=0.4720625, C46='=C54+C55'=56.4720625, C47='=C45-C46'=108.9229375); and (2) while Column D ('Q1 End', dated 6/30/2016) reflects only the post-acquisition balance sheet (D22=138, D23=4.5, D24=4.2, D25=3.3, D27=280, D30=0, D31=145), Column F ('Q2 Start', also dated 6/30/2016) adds the Q1 2016 operating results to Column D (F22='=D22+C43-C54'=242, F23='=D23+C50-C51'=9.895, F27='=SUM(F22:F26)'=389.395, F30='=D30+C55'=0.4720625, F31='=D31+C47'=253.9229375), and Column G ('Q2 End', dated 9/30/2016) adds the Q2 2016 operating results to Column F (G22=362.25, G23=16.29, G27=516.04, G30=1.031625, G31=380.008375). Because the prompt states 'operating results first appear in Q2' instead of explaining that Q1 operating results are computed in C43:C55 and rolled into the balance sheet in the 'Q2 Start' column (F22:F31), all 3 attempts followed the prompt literally and scored 0.0 (modification subscores 0.5000, 0.6154, and 0.6731).
confirmation: Verified: gt EquityMethod C43:C55 hold Q1 2016 formulas and F22='=D22+C43-C54' adds them to Q2 Start, which the 'operating results first appear in Q2' wording does not clearly convey. No run matched.
fix: Same prompt sentence change as verifier-correctness-0.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: Verifier fails all three units (score 0.0) because the ground truth contradicts the prompt's instruction on when operating results appear
evidence: Across all 3 units, 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells, weight: 1) returned score=0.0 (unit 1: regression 1.0000, modification 0.5000, 26 errors; unit 2: regression 1.0000, modification 0.6154, 20 errors; unit 3: regression 1.0000, modification 0.6731, 17 errors). Reconstructing the outputs from the trajectories shows that every unit followed the explicit prompt instruction ('Acquisition closes 3/31/2016 (start of Q1). The Q1 End balance sheet reflects post-acquisition position only; operating results first appear in Q2'): Unit 2 set Q1 operating results (C43:C55) to 0 and set Q2 Start (F22:F31) equal to Q1 End (D22:D31) so that operating results first appeared in Q2 (matching 32/52 modification cells), while Unit 3 and Unit 1 kept Q1 standalone operating profit (C43=160, C54=56, C47=104) but set Q1 affiliate operating results (C50, C51, C44, C55) to 0 and set Q2 Start equal to Q1 End (matching 35/52 and 26/52 modification cells). Because gt_07_03_golden.xlsx instead populates full Q1 operating results in C43:C55 (C44=5.395, C45=165.395, C47=108.9229375, C50=5.5, C51=0.105) and adds Q1 operating results into the 'Q2 Start' column (F22:F31), and because verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells requires mod_ratio == 1.0 to pass, all three instruction-following solutions receive a 0.0 verdict.
confirmation: All three grade.json show 0.0 (modification 0.50/0.62/0.67). The golden computes full Q1 results (C43=160, C44=5.395) and rolls them into 'Q2 Start' F22:F31, while the prompt says 'operating results first appear in Q2'. Instruction-following outputs fail the all-or-nothing check.
fix: prompt.md: changed the sentence 'The Q1 End balance sheet reflects post-acquisition position only; operating results first appear in Q2.' to 'The Q1 End balance sheet reflects post-acquisition position only; Q1 2016 operating results are first reflected in the Q2 Start balance sheet.' This matches the answer key (Q1 2016 income statement C43:C55 populated, rolled into F22:F31) and removes the reading that Q1 results are zero or that Q2 Start equals Q1 End.
